fields.name: enabled
fields.tooltip: Master switch. Off, a dash never slows the clock.

fields.name: threatWindowSeconds
fields.tooltip: How close a hit must be, in game seconds, for the dash that avoids it to count as a last-second dodge.

fields.name: extraReach
fields.tooltip: Added to the ship's half width and half height in the forecast — a near-miss by less than this still counts as a threat on the old line, and the new line must clear by it.

fields.name: minSpeedKmh
fields.tooltip: Below this speed a dash never slows the clock.

fields.name: cooldownSeconds
fields.tooltip: Real seconds after a slow-mo ends before another can start.

fields.name: forecastStepSeconds
fields.tooltip: Slice of the forecast against a spinning rotor gate, game seconds. Smaller is finer and costs more.

fields.name: timeScale
fields.tooltip: The world clock during the dodge.

fields.name: holdUntilProgress
fields.tooltip: The slow-mo holds until the dash has covered this share of its distance (and its window is over), so the whole dash plays in slow motion. 0.5 ends it about when the window does; 1 waits for the very last centimetre.

fields.name: blendInSeconds
fields.tooltip: Ease into the slow-mo, real seconds.

fields.name: blendOutSeconds
fields.tooltip: Ease back to full speed after the dash, real seconds.
